name: Her Age, My Sex, Your location

Dee is a Sophomore in college with the hots for his professor and a fascination with roleplaying game. One day after a raid, she receives a mysterious invitation from an internet stranger and before he knows it, he falls down the rabbit hole that will destroy his identity.
